name: IKS Wide Reach
_comment: R3.46, Module R3 SSD book page 11. Corner YS:125 DK:7 EX:16 CR:8; annex gives crew 40 and 10
boarding parties and the point value 132/112, so bpv 112 (R3.R51's economic/combat split).
The D7E's sister on the D6 hull — the owner called it before either sheet was read, and the
two pages are near enough identical in layout. Same exploration trade: NO APR (the D6 carries
two), labs doubled to eight, two special sensors, one drone rack instead of two, seven
phaser-2s, four cargo boxes, three shuttle boxes.
ONE REAL DIFFERENCE between the sisters, and it is the kind that would be invisible if either
were copied from the other: this ship's special sensors are destroyed on TORPEDO damage
points, the D7E's on PHASER points. Each sheet says so in its own note and the boxes are
drawn in the matching colour. dacHitLocation is the field that carries it (G24.17).
The second difference is the disruptors. This sheet: 'DISRUPTORS HAD A MAXIMUM RANGE OF 22
UNTIL THE B REFIT, 30 THEREAFTER.' The D7E's sheet carries no such note. So these start at 22
and the B refit lengthens them, exactly as the plain D6's do.
WORTH CHECKING when this is reviewed: security 3 and probes 2, both counted off the sheet
rather than inherited from the D6, which has 2 and 1.
_refitComment: UIM REFIT (Y165) +5, B REFIT (Y165) +6, Y175 REFIT +1, all off the ship data table. The B
refit does four things here: raises the shields, installs DERFACS, lengthens the disruptors
from 22 to 30, and converts the type-F rack to type-A. Y175 takes the rack to type-B.
